cc:Work.dc:title: Ant Stack: design ≠ implementation
cc:Work.dc:description: Ant Stack as a proposed Body–Brain–Mind architecture (dashed cards), distinct from implemented analytical workload and energy models (solid cards). Arrows describe intended information flow, not an executed sensorimotor loop. Counter models are not contact, neural, or active-inference solvers and do not establish biological fidelity, real-time performance, or energy efficiency.
